rules: NO Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk, or generic sans for headings.
Avoid default bold; use font-medium or font-semibold for clarity in dense data lists.

colors.background: COLORS.lightBg for main surfaces, COLORS.sectionBg for dense lists.
rules: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays/dropdowns. Use solid backgrounds with borders.
Explicitly set hover text color (e.g., hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900).

visual enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-md or rounded-lg). No card shadows. Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton, use border-b border-border/40 on grid items.
visual enhancers.interactions: Hover states must have slight contrast shifts. Focus states must ring the brand color.
visual enhancers.loading: Per-row or inline loaders (Loader2 animate-spin) instead of full-page flickers.

grids.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards)
rules: Grid items MUST be direct children.
Override stretch with align-items: start where needed.

layouts.ExpenseSetupPanel: Container. Header (Title + Refresh + Bulk Edit toggle). Content: Split 30% Left (Categories) / 70% Right (Items).
layouts.CategoryList: List view. Search top. Sticky 'All Items'. Draggable rows with inline edit.
layouts.ItemList: Header with search. Sticky Quick-Add Row (Name Input + Unit Price Input + Add Btn). Draggable item rows with inline Edit (Name/Cat Dropdown).
layouts.ExpenseBulkEditor: Grid view mimicking MenuManagement BulkEditor pattern. No Import/Export toolbar.

required: Smooth height transitions on inline edits
rules: No `transition: all`. Use specific `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.

accessibility.focus: High contrast ring on inputs and buttons.
accessibility.contrast: APCA ratio compliance. Gray text must be dark enough against lightBg.

media.rules: No media required for this dashboard component.

3d libraries.rules: No 3D libraries required for this dense data table view.

wireframes.Stock_Master_Tab: Split View (30% Left / 70% Right). Left: Categories with inline edit (Pencil) + delete (Trash2) icons on hover. Right: Header with 'Search items...' input. Quick-Add row fixed at top containing [Name Input] [Unit Price Input] [Add Btn]. Below are draggable item rows.
wireframes.Item_Row_Edit_Mode: When editing an item, the row transforms: Name becomes an input, Category becomes a dropdown. Action buttons become [Check (Save)] and [X (Cancel)].
wireframes.Bulk_Edit_Mode: Full table view mimicking Menu BulkEditor. Header with Search, Add Item, Save Changes. Table headers. Each row has an index/status icon, Name input, Category Dropdown, Undo button.
wireframes.Delete_Confirmations: Modal dialog with shadow-xl, border, solid white bg. Overlay bg-black/40. 'Delete Item?' title. Text: 'This item may have linked expense transactions. Deleting will permanently remove the item and all related expense records. This cannot be undone.' Cancel and Delete buttons aligned right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor `ExpenseSetupPanel.jsx` to split into `expense/CategoryList.jsx` and `expense/ItemList.jsx` exactly mirroring the `MenuManagementPanel.jsx` component structure.

In `ItemList.jsx`, add an inline row editing mode. When `editingId === item.id`, swap the row's text cells with a text `<input>` for name and a `<select>` dropdown for category. Provide Save/Cancel buttons.
In `ItemList.jsx`'s quick-add header row, add a Unit Price `<input type='number'>` alongside the Name input (CR-064).

Refactor the API calls and state management to use optimistic UI updates. When a user clicks Save on an inline edit, or Delete, update the local React state immediately and show a per-row spinner while the API call is in flight, avoiding full-panel `fetchAll()` flickers (BUG-162).
Ensure the `ExpenseBulkEditor.jsx` matches the exact visual pattern of `menu/BulkEditor.jsx`, specifically without the Import/Export Excel features.
Preserve all existing delete confirmation modal wording exactly as requested (BUG-201 interim text).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI slop.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use placeholder characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Ensure all dropdowns and overlays have a solid or highly-opaque blurred background. NO transparent overlays.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
